name: taller-contable
description: Sistema contable para taller de motos: API FastAPI + app Expo

scripts.api:lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check app tests
scripts.api:fmt: uv run --directory backend ruff format app tests
scripts.api:migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.check: npm run api:lint && npm run api:types && npm run api:test && npm run app:lint && npm run app:types
scripts.setup: uv sync --directory backend --all-extras && npm --prefix movil install
